2026-2027 release dates
Major economic releases
Data are available at the time of release on the Statistics Canada website (www.statcan.gc.ca) and in summary form in The
Daily. In exceptional circumstances, some release dates may be modified during the year. For more information, contact Media
Relations at statcan.mediahotline-ligneinfomedias.statcan@statcan.gc.ca.
